answer: No account buys its way in: standing here is soulbound reputation, non-transferable and impossible to pool, that only vests by passing live tasks graded by a jury drawn each epoch from the ocean of long-staked elders. A sybil fleet finds no haven, since every mask must earn its own reputation from scratch across many epochs, and a single fake that fails a juried check sends a slashing ripple through the whole ring, burning the shared bond faster than new masks can be minted.
